name: Teen volunteer program at El Paso Animal Services
org: El Paso Animal Services (City of El Paso)
what_you_do: Walk dogs, give enrichment, help with animal care, and greet visitors at the city shelter. The program page does not describe the Cats at the Zoo program.
who_can_apply: Teens 14 to 17 can join the Shelter Volunteer, Cats at the Zoo and Community Service programs. A parent or guardian must go to orientation and basic animal handling training. Teens 14 to 16 must volunteer with a parent or guardian. That adult must also be a registered volunteer.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page. Apply any time.
how_to_apply: Send a volunteer form on the volunteer portal. Then finish orientation in person or in the MyImpact app. Email the volunteer team to book your first day.
notes: Teens 16 and 17 need a parent or guardian to take Level 1 Animal Handling Training too. Maybe you only need service hours for school or NHS. The page says you can email the volunteer team and skip onboarding.
